lines.en: label kaorisummer2morninggen:
scene kaorisummer2morninggen
I wind up getting talked into coming to the diner after calling Kaori and finding out that they’re having some sort of special today.
lines.zh: 我给 Kaori 打了个电话，得知她们今天有什么特价，结果被说动，去了那家餐厅。

lines.en: I am informed upon arrival that {i}I{/i} am special because I am Kaori’s friend and that is what she was actually referring to over the phone.
lines.zh: 到了之后我才知道，所谓的“特别”指的是{i}我{/i}——因为我是 Kaori 的朋友，而她在电话里说的其实就是这个。

lines.en: Both flattered and thankful that I am not being added to the menu, I figure that I might as well stick around and hang out with her in between her light-speed trips to the kitchen and back to help other customers.
lines.zh: 既受宠若惊，又庆幸自己没被写进菜单，我决定干脆留下来，在她以光速往返厨房、招呼其他客人的间隙里陪陪她。

lines.en: On her eighth trip back, I finally decide what I want to eat. Well, kind of.
lines.zh: 在她第八次回来的时候，我终于决定好要吃什么了。算是吧。

lines.en: What I decide is that, in lieu of an actual special that doesn’t fuck teenagers, I want Kaori to make me something herself.
lines.zh: 我决定的是：既然没有真正“不祸害青少年”的今日特价，那就让 Kaori 亲自给我做点什么。

lines.en: She advises me that that is not how a kitchen staff works and that she is not allowed to use the cooking equipment, but then I respond with how the customer is always right and so she is forced to oblige.
lines.zh: 她提醒我，厨房不是这么运作的，而且她不被允许使用烹饪设备；但我回答说顾客永远是对的，于是她只好从命。

lines.en: scene black
Feeling determined to make me something truly special and prove to her boss that she is ready to cook, Kaori declares that she will make me the most special thing I have ever eaten before.
lines.zh: Kaori 决心要给我做点真正特别的东西，也想向老板证明自己已经能下厨了，于是宣布要给我做我有生以来吃过最特别的东西。

lines.en: She uses a lot more words to say that, but fifty percent of them were irrelevant, so I decided to leave them out for your sake.
lines.zh: 她说这话用了多得多的词，但其中百分之五十都无关紧要，所以我为了你好，把它们省略了。

lines.en: She disappears into the kitchen once again, this time for much longer than the several seconds it normally takes for her to reemerge, but what she has in her hands when she does is not special at all.
lines.zh: 她又一次消失在厨房里，这次比平时几秒钟就重新冒头要久得多，可她再出现时手里端着的东西一点也不特别。

lines.en: It’s a peanut butter and jelly sandwich with a side of raw broccoli.
lines.zh: 是一份花生酱果酱三明治，配一碟生西兰花。

lines.en: : Consume the tiny trees, Friend! They will help you walk longer distances!
lines.zh: : 吃掉那些小树吧，朋友！它们会让你走得更远！

lines.en: I ask for a to-go box and decide to just...eat this later.
lines.zh: 我要了个打包盒，决定还是……晚点再吃这个。

lines.en: $ kaori_love += 1
$ pbj += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
{i}You have obtained a peanut butter and jelly sandwich and broccoli!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你获得了花生酱果酱三明治和西兰花！{/i}
